subject: Rebook: demo missed due to timezone mismatch (Tokyo)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp>
Cc: Maria Ito <maria.ito@kyu-systems.jp>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 01:05:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: missed demo this morning — quick reschedule?

Hi Kenji / Maria,

I saw we missed each other for the demo slot scheduled for today. I dug into the calendar event and it looks like the invite was created with Pacific Time (PT) as the event zone, which would have placed the meeting at very different local hours for your Tokyo-based team — totally my mistake.

Would you be open to rebooking? To avoid any future confusion I can:
- Send an updated invite explicitly set to JST (Asia/Tokyo)
- Offer two short options (30m demo + 15m Q&A) in your local business hours
- Loop in my manager for a short trial/credit should you want to test Redwood in a sandbox after the demo

Proposed slots (all JST):
- Tue Nov 17, 10:30–11:15 JST
- Tue Nov 17, 15:00–15:45 JST
- Wed Nov 18, 11:00–11:45 JST

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (preview), updated-invite-jst.ics (will send corrected calendar after you confirm a time)

If those don't work, tell me a few windows and I’ll adjust. Apologies again for the mix-up — I appreciate your patience.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

----
On the call length: typical demo is ~30 minutes but we can extend to 45 if you want a deeper look at routing and cost controls.

From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Ito <maria.ito@kyu-systems.jp>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 02:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: missed demo this morning — quick reschedule?

Hi Connor,

Thanks for checking — and no worries, these timezone conversions are surprisingly easy to get wrong. We were ready on our side at ~10:00 this morning JST but didn’t see an incoming Zoom link. Maria and I assumed the meeting was on our calendar at 10:00 JST (we didn't realize PT had been used).

Both proposed times on Tue Nov 17 could work for us; 10:30–11:15 JST is preferable. A 30 minute demo is fine for initial run-through; we may book a follow-up for deeper technical questions. Could you please send the corrected calendar invite with the explicit Asia/Tokyo timezone and a Zoom link?

Also, roughly how long is the live demo environment available afterwards? We want to test some inference runs with our sample prompts.

Thanks,
Kenji
Senior Product Manager, Kyu Systems
kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp

----
On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 01:05 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> I saw we missed each other for the demo slot scheduled for today...

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp>
Cc: Maria Ito <maria.ito@kyu-systems.jp>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 03:15:00 +0000
Subject: Confirmed — updated invite sent for Tue Nov 17 10:30 JST

Hi Kenji / Maria,

Thanks for the quick reply — great, Tue Nov 17 at 10:30–11:15 JST is confirmed. I just sent a corrected calendar invite (attached .ics and live Google Calendar event) set explicitly to Asia/Tokyo so the time displays correctly in your calendars. Zoom link is included in the invite.

A couple notes:
- I’ve CC'd my manager Marissa so she’s aware (and can approve a short sandbox window afterwards if you want one).
- We'll aim for a focused 30m demo: 15m platform walkthrough + 15m live Q&A with an optional follow-up.
- I'll bring a short example using your use case (routing to cheaper model variants when latency allows).

Attachments: updated-invite-jst.ics, redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Could you please accept the invite when convenient? That will lock the slot and surface it in our calendars.

Best,
Connor

----
On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 02:20 AM Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp> wrote:
> Both proposed times on Tue Nov 17 could work for us; 10:30–11:15 JST is preferable...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 04:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Confirmed — updated invite sent for Tue Nov 17 10:30 JST

Connor, Kenji,

Thanks for looping me in. Connor — I reviewed the situation and approved a one-week sandbox extension for Kyu Systems after the demo so they can run some inference tests with their sample prompts. No billing impact for the first week.

Kenji — welcome, and looking forward to the demo. If you need any compliance docs ahead of time (SOC2 summary, data handling notes), reply here and I’ll drop them in.

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

----
On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 03:15 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> I just sent a corrected calendar invite (attached .ics and live Google Calendar event) set explicitly to Asia/Tokyo...

From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kyu-systems.jp>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 06:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Confirmed — updated invite sent for Tue Nov 17 10:30 JST

All good — I accepted the invite. Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sandbox offer, Marissa. We’ll prepare a couple of prompts and a short dataset to run after the demo.

See you Tue at 10:30 JST (Zoom link in calendar).

Best regards,
Kenji

----
Thread metadata: invitations updated, calendar invite corrected to Asia/Tokyo, one-week sandbox approved by Sales Ops.
